Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 952 - 1986 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
FOGNOZZLE FOR FIRE BRIGADE USE 



(First Revision) 



0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard ( First Revision ) was adopted by the Indian 
Standards Institution on 30 June 1986, after the draft finalized by the 
Fire Fighting Sectional Committee had been approved by the Civil 
Engineering Division Council. 

0,2 Fognozzle is a type of hand-controlled branch in which the operator 
can apply water to a heated surface of fire in the form of either a fog 
( fine mist ) or a jet. The added advantage over other hand-controlled 
branch is that water fog affects uniform cooling of the surface over which 
it is applied, the cooling effect is maximum and the water can be con- 
served. The throw from a fognozzle is considerably reduced when it is 
used for the application of fog. If necessary, the operator can use an 
extension applicator, carrying a fog-head at its end, which can be fitted 
to the fognozzle. 

0.3 While using the fognozzle, great care shall always be taken regarding 
operation of hand-controls, particularly when shutting off. This shall 
be done gradually, as otherwise it may easily cause serious damage to 
hose and may also be a source of danger to the branchman and others 
in the vicinity. 

0.4 This standard was first published in 1969. This revision has been 
prepared so as to give flexibility in the design covering essential dimen- 
sions and keeping requirements based on performance requirement. The 
present design is based on design developed so far, 

0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of 
this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, 
expressing the' result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accord- 
ance with IS : 2-1960*. The number of significant places retained in 
the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value 
in this standard. 



♦Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ), 

3 



IS ; 952 - 1986 

1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard lays down the requirements regarding material, shape, 
construction and performance tests for fognozzle for fire brigade use. 

2. MATERIALS 

2*1 Castings and Forgings — Castings and forgings shall be made of 
any of the materials given in 2.1.1 and 2.1«2. 

2.U Copper Alloys — Copper alloys used for castings or forgings shall 
conform to the requirements given below: 

a) Sand castings Grade LTD 2 of IS : 318-1981* or 

Grade HTB 1 of IS : 304-l981t 

b) Die castings Grade 3 of IS : 292-1 983 J 

c) Hot forgings Grade 1 of IS : 291-1977§ 

d) Gravity die castings IS : 1264-1981|| 

2.1.2 Ahiminium alloys used for castings shall conform to Designation 
4450, 4425 and 4600 of IS : 617-19751f. 

2*2 Spring — The phosphor bronze wire used for the spring to be used 
in case of copper alloy couplings shall conform to IS : 7608-1975** and 
stainless steel wire used for both types shall conform to IS : 6528-1 972tt" 

2.3 Washer — Washer shall conform to IS : 937-1 981 JJ. 

2*4 Extension Applicator — It shall be of aluminium alloy tubes 
conforming to IS : 738-1977§§. 

3. SHAPE AND DIMENSIONS 

3.1 The typical shape and essential dimensions of the fognozzle shall be 
as given in Fig. 1. The length of applicator, if used, shall not be less 
than 1 '75 m ( along central line ) and nozzle end shall have a bend of 
90 to 100**. The threads at the two ends shall have a length of not less 
than 20 mm and shall be such as to suit insertion on the body and fitting 
of nozzle. 



♦Specification for leaded tin bronze ingots and castings ( second revision ). 

tSpecification for high tensile brass ingots and castings ( second revision ), 

{Specification for leaded brass ingots and castings ( second revision ). 

fspecification for naval brass rods and sections ( suitable for machining and forging ) 
( second revision ). 

H Specification for brass gravity die castings ingots and castings ( second revision ). 

^Specification for aluminium and aluminium alloy ingots and castings for general 
engineering purposes ( second revision ) . 

•♦Specification for phosphor bronze wires ( for general engineering purposes ). 

ttSpecification for stainless steel wire. 

jjspecification for washers for water fittings for fire fighting purposes ( second revision )i 

§§Spe<;ification for wrought aluminium and aluminium alloy drawn tube for general 
engineering purposes ( second revision ).

IS : 952 - 1986 

4. PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS 

4.1 The fognozzle head of the fognozzle shall have a flow not less than 
225 1/min and jet head of the fognozzle shall have a flow of not less 
than 400 1/min at a pressure of 7 kgf/cm^ at the inlet of the fognozzle. 
If the equipment is with applicator, an additional test shall also be 
conducted with applicator attached to the fog-head for the requirement 
of the fog. 

4.2 The fog-head on the fognozzle shall produce a cone ( see 4.2.1 ) of 
high velocity fog comprising of finely atomised droplets of uniform size; 
at an operating pressure of 07 MN/mm^ ( 7 kgf/cm^ ). The discharge 
pattern of the fog shall be such that no pockets are left while it is being 
used on an inflammable liquid surface. 

-4.2.1 The angle of the cone of fog produced shall not be less than 90* 
and not more than 120° at the apex. 

4.3 The horizontal reach of the fog pattern shall not be less than 6 m 
from the fog-head on the fognozzle and not less than 4*5 m from the 
fog-head on the extension applicator when operating at a pressure of 
0-7 MN/mm2 ( 7 kgf/cm2 ) in still air. 

5. WORKMANSHIP AND FINISH 

5.1 All parts shall be of good workmanship and finish and shall be free 
from burrs and sharp edges. All castings shall be clean and sound and 
free from plugging, welding or any repaired defects. 

6. MARKING 

6.1 Each fognozzle with its applicator shall be clearly and permanently 
marked with the following information: 

a) Manufacturer's name or trade-mark; 

b) Year of manufacture; and 

c) The length of applicator, if provided. 

6.1.1 The product may also be marked with Standard mark. . 

6.2 The use of the Standard Mark is governed by the provisions of the 
Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 1986 and the Rules and Regulations made 
thereunder. The details of conditions under which the licence for the use of 
Standard Mark may be granted to manufacturers or producers may be obtained 
from the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



7. CRITERIA FOR CONFORMITY 

7.1 Each fognozzle with its applicator shall be checked for the require- 
ments given in this standard.
